keyEvents.text: Goal! Burton Albion 1, AFC Rushden & Diamonds 0. Will Collar (Burton Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Burton Albion 2, AFC Rushden & Diamonds 0. Raphael Borges Rodrigues (Burton Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Mark O'Mahony (Burton Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Max Prickett-Reed (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Will Collar (Burton Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
